For discounts, staffing, equipment, quality-cost, fairness, satisfaction, drifting, notes, the two drills and the error envelope I judged from the text dump alone — findings there assume the line is visible and not screen-reader-only.
The .xlsx files themselves were not produced or opened; only the on-screen export caption was judged.
blind_spot: innerText includes screen-reader-only text, and this module has plenty of it — every chart is followed by an sr-only <table> repeating its values (proven by exec-overview.png, where the 'קטגוריה | הכנסה 2026 | …' block in the dump is nowhere on the screen). So any finding of mine that rests on a line I did not also see in a PNG could be text no sighted reader ever meets. The mechanical check, on eight of my rows: grep the reports module for the class that hides a node (sr-only) on the elements that render 'השאלה שהעמודות עונות עליה', 'אין במערכת מושג "עמדה"', 'המיסוך מתבצע בלשונית', 'הספירות מוצגות כ"N מתוך M" ולא באחוזים (📐11)' and the model-name footer of ניתוח הערות — each hit voids that finding, each miss confirms it.
